results.sql: select sum(wafers_passed) * 1.0 / sum(wafers_tested) as yield_rate from gold.agg_yield_daily
select sum(wafers_failed) as wafers_failed from gold.agg_yield_daily
select lot_id, yield_rate from gold.agg_yield_by_lot order by yield_rate asc, lot_id limit 5
select sensor_id, effect_size from gold.rpt_sensor_fail_signal order by signal_rank, sensor_id limit 10
select count(*) as n_unusable from gold.dim_sensor where not is_usable
select test_date, yield_rate from gold.agg_yield_daily order by yield_rate asc, test_date limit 1

select d.step_name, sum(case when f.is_out_of_control then 1 else 0 end) as n_ooc from gold.fct_sensor_reading f join gold.dim_sensor d on f.sensor_id = d.sensor_id group by d.step_name order by n_ooc desc, d.step_name limit 1
select is_fail, avg(n_missing_readings) as avg_missing from gold.fct_wafer_test group by is_fail order by is_fail
select lot_id, n_wafers from gold.dim_lot order by lot_id limit 5
select tool_id, count(*) as n from gold.rpt_sensor_fail_signal where signal_rank <= 20 group by tool_id order by n desc, tool_id limit 1
select sum(wafers_passed) * 1.0 / sum(wafers_tested) as yield_rate from gold.agg_yield_daily where test_date >= date '2008-09-01' and test_date < date '2008-10-01'
select date_trunc('month', test_date) as month, sum(wafers_passed) * 1.0 / sum(wafers_tested) as yield_rate from gold.agg_yield_daily group by 1 order by 1
select sum(wafers_tested) as wafers_tested from gold.agg_yield_daily
select count(*) as n_lots from gold.dim_lot
select count(*) as n_lots from gold.agg_yield_by_lot where wafers_failed = 0
select test_date from gold.rpt_yield_p_chart where is_above_limit order by test_date
select distinct centre_line from gold.rpt_yield_p_chart
select sensor_id from gold.ml_sensor_signal_significance where passes_fdr order by sensor_id
select sensor_id from gold.ml_sensor_signal_significance where beats_shuffle_max order by sensor_id
select step_name, count(*) as n_usable from gold.dim_sensor where is_usable group by step_name order by step_name
select count(*) as n from gold.dim_sensor where missing_rate > 0.5
select count(*) as n_constant from gold.dim_sensor where is_constant
select avg(case when is_missing then 1.0 else 0.0 end) as missing_share from gold.fct_sensor_reading
select avg(case when is_out_of_control then 1.0 else 0.0 end) as ooc_share from gold.fct_sensor_reading where is_out_of_control is not null
select is_fail, avg(n_out_of_control) as avg_ooc from gold.fct_wafer_test where not is_reference_period group by is_fail order by is_fail
select wafer_id, anomaly_score from gold.ml_wafer_anomaly_scores where split = 'test' order by anomaly_score desc, wafer_id limit 10
select sum(case when is_fail then 1 else 0 end) as fails from (select is_fail from gold.ml_wafer_anomaly_scores where split = 'test' order by anomaly_score desc, wafer_id limit 78)
select tool_id, count(*) as n from gold.dim_sensor where step_name = 'etch' group by tool_id order by n desc, tool_id limit 1
select step_name, count(*) as n_tools from gold.dim_tool group by step_name order by step_name
select yield_rate from gold.agg_yield_by_lot where lot_id = 'LOT0010'
